ResearchGoal: Outcome Advantage describes a final-game win-rate tendency, not a guaranteed lane or game result.

Recommendation.Rule: Minimum sample 20; |win rate - 50%| at least 5 percentage points; 80% Wilson interval must exclude 50%; no reliability-specific exception.
Recommendation.SuggestedTerminology: 우세 경향 / 뚜렷한 차이 없음 / 열세 경향
Reasons: Protects all n<20 matchups from an outcome judgment.
Requires both statistical evidence and a user-visible practical effect.
Keeps one symmetric, explainable rule across every role.
Uses 80% rather than 95% evidence to avoid making the current sparse dataset almost entirely unclassified.
